exportWebReadme:
# Run this game

Serve this folder with a static HTTP server. For a local preview, run `python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 8000` in this folder and open http://localhost:8000. Deploy the entire folder together. An installable web app requires HTTPS or localhost. See compatibility.json for the build report.
exportCapacitorReadme:
# Build this Capacitor project

Use Node.js 22 or newer. Run `npm install` in this folder, then `npm run add:ios` or `npm run add:android` once. Run `npm run sync` to copy the web game into the platforms, and `npm run open:ios` or `npm run open:android` to open the project in Xcode (macOS) or Android Studio. Build, sign and distribute using the platform IDE. The browser game is in www/. See compatibility.json for the build report.

networkServerReadme:
# Colyseus room server

Run `node server.mjs` with Node.js 22 or newer. It reads rules.json next to the script. HOST and PORT set the listener, and default to 0.0.0.0 and 2567. Host the game files separately. Set the published server URL in OliveStudio to the server or its TLS proxy. HTTPS games use wss://. Keep this folder beside the game output for deployment.
